title: An edit to a linked part shows in the score and the part

steps.note: a note edit in the master reaches the Flute part (A4 = 69 appears nowhere else in the flute)

questions: Part name addressing: the master's part is 'Clarinet in B♭' (with the flat sign) but its excerpt is named 'Clarinet in Bb'; which name does staff.part match (and is ASCII 'Bb' accepted)?
parts-linked.mscz reports needSave=true right after opening (seen in this harness); the stale-state and undo checks are unaffected, but the conductor may want to know.
Editing from a part view (current view = an excerpt) is not scriptable: there is no command to switch the current view; S20 edits the master and checks the excerpts in the mscz export.

Settled 2026-10-29 (P2.3): write_voice takes staff (1-based) and content as voice lines 'm<N> v<V> | ...' exactly as score_read prints them; validation problems are E_INVALID_ARG naming the bar and voice; an unknown staff is E_RANGE.
